CVE-2023-32627.title: A floating point exception vulnerability was found in sox, in the ...
CVE-2023-32627.description: A floating point exception vulnerability was found in sox, in the read_samples function at sox/src/voc.c:334:18. This flaw can lead to a denial of service.

CVE-2026-129264.title: A security vulnerability has been detected in sox_ng up to 14.8.1 ...
CVE-2026-129264.description: A security vulnerability has been detected in sox_ng up to 14.8.1. Affected by this issue is the function read_samples_voc of the file src/voc.c of the component VOC Decoder. Such manipulation leads to out-of-bounds write. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. The name of the patch is 0b40408b. A patch should be applied to remediate this issue. The vendor was contacted early, responded in a very professional manner and quickly released a fixed version of the affected product.
